{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS071 |prevtitle=Muk Raking |nextcode=PS073 |nexttitle=Valiant Venomoth! |series=Yellow |colorscheme=Yellow}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Weezing Winks Out |title_ja=VSマタドガス |title_ro=VS Matadogas |image=PS072.png |scheme=Yellow |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 72 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|6}} |pub2=VIZ Media monthly issue |pub2-data=Chapter 32 in [[Best Enemies]] |pub3=VIZ Media full volume |pub3-data=Adventure 72 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|6}} |location=[[Cerise Island]] }} '''Weezing Winks Out''' (Japanese: '''VSマタドガス''' ''VS {{tt|Matadogas|Weezing}}'') is the 72nd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 32nd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Blue}} has his eyes {{status|paralyzed}} shut, and [[Koga]] has an {{p|Arbok}} {{m|wrap}}ped around him, immobilizing him in his battle against [[Agatha]]: {{p|Arbok}} vs. Arbok. Koga's Arbok tries to attack with a {{m|Glare}} attack, which fails. Agatha's Arbok gives Koga's Arbok a hard {{m|Body Slam}}. Then it releases Koga's Arbok and {{m|bite}}s its tail off, apparently knocking Arbok out. Enraged, Koga sends out {{p|Weezing}} and {{p|Muk}} and tells them to use {{m|Poison Gas}} and {{m|Smog}}, which are repelled by a new invulnerability pattern of Arbok's. It then attacks Muk and Weezing, knocking them out. Koga throws five ninja stars at Agatha, which miss. Then, to Agatha's surprise, Koga's Arbok grows a new tail. Agatha sneers at Koga for thinking that that will make him win, and then, {{TP|Koga|Golbat}} returns. However, it is Koga's Golbat, not Agatha's. Blue then appears with his eyes open. The ninja stars Koga threw were {{i|Poké Ball}} ninja stars, and the Pokémon inside were holding [[Paralyze Heal|paralysis-healing medicine]]. Koga's Golbat then uses {{m|Leech Life}} on Koga. It then spits Koga's blood at Agatha's Arbok's pattern, covering and destroying the effects of the pattern. Agatha's Arbok tries a {{m|Bind}} attack, but [[Blue's Golduck]] uses {{m|Confusion}} defeating Agatha's Arbok and Agatha. Afterwards, Koga and Blue leave and continue though [[Cerise Island]]. ==Major events== * [[Koga]] and {{adv|Blue}} defeat [[Agatha]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} (flashback) * {{adv|Blue}} * [[Koga]] * [[Agatha]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Golduck}} ({{OP|Blue|Golduck}}) * {{p|Golbat}} ({{OP|Koga|Golbat}}) * {{p|Arbok}} ([[Koga]]'s) * {{p|Muk}} ([[Koga]]'s) * {{p|Weezing}} ([[Koga]]'s) * {{p|Arbok}} ([[Agatha]]'s) * {{p|Golbat}} ([[Agatha]]'s) ==Trivia== *[[Koga]] gives his Pokémon items to hold while in their [[Poké Ball]]s, which wouldn't appear in the games until [[Generation II|the next Generation]]. ===Errors=== *In the last frame before [[Agatha]] changes her {{p|Arbok}}'s pattern from "attack" to "invulnerability" it already appears changed. *Three frames after Agatha's Arbok's pattern is erased, it appears to not be erased. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 雙彈瓦斯|VS Weezing}} (Taiwan)
